name: labx-monitoring-platform
description: LabX Centralized Computer Resource Utilization and Performance Monitoring Platform

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('public')) fs.mkdirSync('public'); ['index.html','agent.py','labx-installer.bat','install-agent.sh'].forEach(f => fs.existsSync(f) && fs.copyFileSync(f, 'public/'+f)); ['css','js'].forEach(d => fs.existsSync(d) && fs.cpSync(d, 'public/'+d, {recursive: true})); console.log('Static build ready in public/');"
